text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No, well... I just noticed we were 
running out of hand soap in the Trainer's 
office, is all."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm planning to go shopping today 
anyway, so would you like me to pick that 
up for you while I'm at it?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, we're almost out 
of tissues... ...I'll check on that 
later."
